hero.desc: the man with a tight topknot, a few wet strands over his forehead, an old scar across his brow bone and a dark indigo, near-black robe with subtle tone-on-tone embroidery

hero_full.desc: the same man's full-length costume: near-black robe, leather belt and a long sword in a dark scabbard at his waist

boss.desc: the grim middle-aged leader in a wide black bamboo hat with a metal crest and a black embroidered robe

henchmen.desc: the swordsmen in low black woven bamboo hats hiding their eyes, soaked black robes and leather belts, each holding a long sabre

scene.desc: an ancient courtyard on a rainy night, dark timber corridors and pillars, grey-tiled eaves pouring water, wet reflective stone paving and dim warm lanterns in a cold blue night
